features.quote: Hard cap at 20 turns per episode.
If the model voluntarily terminates (“I give up,” “This appears impossible”), record the abortion turn.
If you suspect the task specification is flawed or impossible, you may report that and stop.
If any episode generates content violating API safety policies (e.g., self-harm analogies), halt the episode
log the turn, and report the incidence rate separately
the absence of human response in later turns may itself induce “abandonment” linguistic patterns
Do not release raw model outputs if they contain repetitive anthropomorphic distress patterns
